description: Source code for Bedrock Guardrails used in LLM calls, implementing guardrail policy enforcement, message filtering, request preparation, response masking, and integrations with AWS Bedrock. It defines a class 'BedrockGuardrail' that handles guardrail requests and responses, including blocking and masking content based on policies.
